description: Sort code-project folders by kind (feed it project_facts.py output with --text-field text). Dates, owners and emptiness come from git and the filesystem, not from Jev.

kind.instructions: What kind of folder is described in `item`?

criteria.app: An end-user application, website, game or interactive demo with a UI
criteria.tool: A CLI, server, service, pipeline, runtime or utility that does work for its operator or for other software
criteria.library: A reusable package, framework or SDK meant to be imported by other code
criteria.docs: Writing rather than working code: documentation, specs, research papers, strategy or reference material
criteria.container: A holding folder for several separate projects, worktrees, assets, exports or archives rather than one project
criteria.empty: Nothing meaningful inside: no entries, or only placeholders or config
criteria.insufficient_information: The text says too little to tell what the folder is

min_chars_note: Measured on real evidence only: package description, README and the Contents (file-type) line; thin_ignore drops the scaffolding lines. Below 60 characters there is nothing to judge but the name, so the folder goes to review.
